fusions.name: Loaded Slivers
fusions.desc: Fires a sliver of the blade at the first enemy within 9 tiles, dealing 7 damage. Holds 5 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Point-Blank Report
fusions.desc: A cut at arm's length that deals 32 damage, is always a critical hit, stuns the target for 1 second and sets it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Cocked and Ready
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Glancing Shard
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, a shard leaps to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles, dealing 6 damage. Once every 5 seconds.
